text:
- [IRET.1.9] **Agenda sorted by (terminal ordinal ASC,
  creation_timetag ASC).** The ordinal is the rule's index in
  canonical source order ([RLOW.14.3]) and decides between any
  two rules; the creation timetag ascends with completion order
  and decides only among activations of ONE rule. No hash-order
  dependence in agenda selection, and no dependence on
  completion order between rules ([RARC.5.4.7]).

idris.name: Ldet_5_5__sorted
idris.note: One rule's agenda sorted by creation timetag ascending, as a predicate on its terminal.

idris.name: Ldet_5_9__ordered
idris.note: Every rule's agenda sorted by creation timetag under the engine's working memory, with the view.

idris.name: Ldet_5_5__sorted_tuples
idris.note: The agenda order of the clause, on one rule's tuples: ascending creation timetag.
